SELECT ui.id, ui.user_id AS userId, u.username, ui.item_code AS itemCode, si.item_code AS itemName, NULL AS itemType, ui.quantity, ui.is_equipped AS isEquipped, ui.acquired_at AS acquiredAt FROM t_user_item ui LEFT JOIN t_user u ON ui.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN t_shop_item si ON ui.item_code = si.item_code
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
AND si.item_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{itemName}, '%')
ORDER BY ui.acquired_at DESC
